title: Quasi-finite compact support is exact and agrees with compactifications
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $h:V\to T$ be a separated quasi-finite morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-quasifinite, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Here Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. On the small etale sites use constant-$A$ module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a module sheaf $F$, use the proper-support functor of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]: let $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!F$ be the subsheaf of $h_*F$ whose sections on an etale $W\to T$ are those sections of $F$ on $V\times_TW$ with support proper over $W$. Support is the closed set of nonzero geometric germs; give it its reduced induced closed subscheme structure [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Then $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is exact, and for every compactification $c=(j:V\hookrightarrow\overline V,r:\overline V\to T)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$c_h:Rr_*Dj_!\xrightarrow{\sim}D(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)$$
on the entire unbounded categories, where the left side is the compact-support candidate [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $D(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!)$ applies the exact functor termwise. It is independent of compactification under the proper-refinement comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $B$ be another Noetherian scheme and $e:T\to B$ another separated quasi-finite morphism of finite type. For the composable morphisms $h,e$, these comparisons satisfy
$$c_{eh}\circ\alpha_{e,h}=D(\sigma_{e,h})\circ(c_eD(h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!))\circ(Re_!c_h),$$
where $\alpha_{e,h}:Re_!Rh_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(eh)_!$ is the compact-support composition of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and $\sigma_{e,h}:e^{\mathrm{supp}}_!h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!\xrightarrow{\sim}(eh)^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is the identification of sections with proper support of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. In particular, for every separated etale finite-type morphism $h:V\to T$ of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], these assertions apply and $h^{\mathrm{supp}}_!$ is canonically the sum-extension functor of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]; under this identification $\sigma_{e,h}$ for etale $e,h$ is the comparison sending a nested summand indexed by lifts $W\to T$, $W\to V$ to the summand indexed by the composite lift $W\to V$. For the identity morphism and its identity compactification, the comparison is the identity, and the same normalization holds for other compactifications under their canonical refinement identifications.
